results.question: How many customers are from Brazil?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE country = 'Brazil'

results.question: How many shipped orders are there?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped'

results.question: What is the price of the Coffee Maker?
results.generated_sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE product_name = 'Coffee Maker'

results.question: List the product names in the Books category that cost less than 20 dollars.
results.generated_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE category = 'Books' AND price < 20

results.question: What is the average price of Home products?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM products p WHERE p.category = 'Home'

results.question: How many customers have placed more than 4 orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 4)

results.question: What is the highest product price in each category?
results.generated_sql: SELECT MAX(p.price) AS max_price FROM products p GROUP BY p.category

results.question: How many orders contain more than 2 line items?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(order_item_id) > 2) AS subquery

results.question: How many orders were placed by customers from Australia?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Australia'

results.question: How many units of Desk Lamp have been sold?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Desk Lamp'

results.question: What is the revenue from Sports products?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Sports' AND o.status = 'completed'

results.question: What is the average order value for shipped orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped'

results.question: How many orders did customers from the USA place in 2024?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'USA' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024

results.question: What is the total quantity sold for each product category?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category

results.question: How many orders were placed in December 2024?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2024 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 12

results.question: How many customers signed up in the first half of 2023?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-06-30'

results.question: What was the revenue in 2025?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 AND o.status = 'completed'

results.question: How many orders were placed on or after 2025-01-01?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01'

results.question: What is the average delivery time of an order?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM o.order_date - o.order_date) + 1) AS avg_delivery_time FROM orders o

results.question: How many employees work at the company?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

results.question: Which customers are subscribed to the newsletter?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM customers WHERE email LIKE '%@newsletter%'

results.question: What is the average weight of a product?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM products

results.question: What payment method did customer 5 use?
results.generated_sql: SELECT o.status FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id = 5

results.question: Which warehouse ships the most orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT o.warehouse FROM orders o GROUP BY o.warehouse ORDER BY COUNT(o.order_id) DESC LIMIT 1
